text:
How can I know the status of Aadhaar generation against NRC Biometric Enrolment (NRC-BME) and how will I get my Aadhaar number?
You can check the status of Aadhaar generation from https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in/CheckAadhaarStatus by entering enrolment number (Enrolment ID), date and time given on the acknowledgement slip. If status is displayed as “Your Aadhaar has been generated”: You can view and download the electronic copy of Aadhaar i.e. e-Aadhaar from https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in/genricDownloadAadhaar This requires mobile OTP authentication received on mobile number and can be availed of only if mobile number is provided at the time of enrolment. This service is free of charge. You may also order Aadhaar PVC card from https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in/genricPVC by providing Aadhaar number or Enrolment ID along with date and timestamp. This service can be availed of even if your mobile number is not linked with your Aadhaar. In such case, you can order PVC card by providing any mobile number to receive OTP for verification. The PVC card will be dispatched to the address which was provided at the time of enrolment. This service is chargeable at Rs. 50/- per Aadhaar PVC card. Aadhaar number can be retrieved and downloaded by visiting any Aadhaar Enrolment Centre in person through “Print Aadhaar” option by providing Enrolment ID and authenticate yourself by (finger print or iris). This service is chargeable at Rs. 30/- per print. The Aadhaar letter shall also be delivered on the address provided at the time of enrolment. If status displayed is “ This enrolment is under process. Please check again after a few days. ”, please contact UIDAI Helpline number 1947 (Toll Free).

title: I had not provided my mobile number at the time of enrolment or the mobile number provided earlier is no longer in use. How can I find my Aadhaar number?
text:
I had not provided my mobile number at the time of enrolment or the mobile number provided earlier is no longer in use. How can I find my Aadhaar number?
Option 1: Aadhaar number can be retrieved and downloaded by visiting an Aadhaar Enrolment Centre in person through “Print Aadhaar” option by providing Enrolment ID and authenticate yourself by (finger print or iris). This service is chargeable at Rs. 30/- per print. Option 2: You may also order Aadhaar PVC card from https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in/genricPVC by providing Aadhaar number or Enrolment ID along with date and timestamp. This service can be availed even if your mobile number is not linked with your Aadhaar. In such case you can order PVC card by providing any mobile number to receive OTP for verification. The PVC card will be dispatched to the address which was provided at the time of enrolment. This service is chargeable at Rs. 50/- per Aadhaar PVC card. Option 3: Call UIDAI Helpline number 1947 (Toll Free). After selecting Language option, Key-in option 1 (request status) followed by option 2 (request of Aadhaar enrolment status). Enter the Enrolment ID number available with you. Enter DOB (DD:MM:YYYY) and after that enter the area Pin code If match is found IVRS shall communicate the Aadhaar number.

title: I have lost the Acknowledgement copy of NRC Biometric Enrolment (NRC-BME). I had not provided my mobile number at the time of enrolment or the mobile number provided earlier is no longer in use. How can I find my Aadhaar number?
text:
I have lost the Acknowledgement copy of NRC Biometric Enrolment (NRC-BME). I had not provided my mobile number at the time of enrolment or the mobile number provided earlier is no longer in use. How can I find my Aadhaar number?
Option 1: Please Visit an Aadhaar Enrolment Centre in person and inform the operator that you want to avail ‘Print Aadhaar` service. Provide the following mandatory information: Name, gender and district or Pincode as provided by you at the time of enrolment. If needed, additional available demographic details such as year of birth, C/O, State etc. may also be asked for narrowing down the search. After biometric authentication (fingerprint or iris), if a match is found, the operator will provide printout of the Aadhaar. This service is chargeable at Rs. 30/- per print. Option 2: Call UIDAI Helpline number 1947 (Toll Free). After selecting Language option, Key-in option 9 (talk to call centre representative). Provide Demographics details (Name, Address, Pincode, DOB etc.) to the representative. If match is found, Enrolment ID will be provided on call by the representative. Once Enrolment ID is obtained. Call UIDAI Helpline number 1947 (Toll free) again. After selecting Language option, Key-in option 1 (request status) followed by option 2 (request of Aadhaar enrolment status). Enter the EID number provided to you by the call centre representative. Enter DOB (DD:MM:YYYY) and after that enter the area Pin code If match is found IVRS shall communicate the Aadhaar number.

title: I have lost the Acknowledgement copy of NRC Biometric Enrolment (NRC-BME), also I do not remember exact name spelling, mobile number, Pincode, address, etc. given at the time of enrolment?
text:
I have lost the Acknowledgement copy of NRC Biometric Enrolment (NRC-BME), also I do not remember exact name spelling, mobile number, Pincode, address, etc. given at the time of enrolment?
In case there is no record of enrolment number (Enrolment ID), Acknowledgement copy, mobile number or demographic details like exact name spelling, Pincode, etc, you may contact UIDAI Regional Office Guwahati by email at helpdesk[dot]roghy[at]uidai[do]net[dot]in or by call at 0361-2221819.

title: I am Indian having Aadhaar, now residing outside India and have obtained foreign citizenship. Do I need to convert my Aadhaar as resident foreign national. And what is the process for the same?
text:
I am Indian having Aadhaar, now residing outside India and have obtained foreign citizenship. Do I need to convert my Aadhaar as resident foreign national. And what is the process for the same?
No change is required as of now. You may keep using the Aadhaar till any further intimation in this regard by UIDAI through website or any other modes.

title: I am resident foreign national possessing Aadhaar as resident Indian without validity, what is the process to convert the same as foreign national?
text:
I am resident foreign national possessing Aadhaar as resident Indian without validity, what is the process to convert the same as foreign national?
You may keep using the Aadhaar till any further intimation in this regard by UIDAI through website or any other modes.

title: Who all are eligible for Aadhaar enrolment as resident foreigner?
text:
Who all are eligible for Aadhaar enrolment as resident foreigner?
All resident foreign nationals (Indian VISA/LTV holder, OCI card holder and citizen of Nepal/Bhutan) who resided in India for 182 days or more in 12 months immediately preceding enrolment application date are eligible for Aadhaar enrolment as resident foreigner.

title: I am Foreign National residing in India; am I eligible for Aadhaar enrolment and which form I have to use for enrolment?
text:
I am Foreign National residing in India; am I eligible for Aadhaar enrolment and which form I have to use for enrolment?
Yes, resident foreign nationals who resided in India for 182 days or more in 12 months immediately preceding enrolment application date are eligible for Aadhaar enrolment by visiting Aadhaar Seva Kendra and submitting demographic details (supported by valid documents) and biometrics details. Resident Foreign National to apply on form no. 7 or form no. 8 for enrolment.

title: What supporting documents are required for enrolment as a foreigner having valid Indian VISA?
text:
What supporting documents are required for enrolment as a foreigner having valid Indian VISA?
Documents required for enrolment as a foreigner having valid Indian VISA given below: POI: Valid VISA, along with valid foreign passport issued, to foreign nationals. POA: Valid Registration Certificate or Residential permit issued by Foreigners Regional Registration Office (FRRO) /Foreigners Registration Office (FRO) to the foreign national OR Any document having Indian address from list of valid supporting document. For detail list of valid documents please visit: List of Supporting Documents

title: What is the difference in resident foreign nationals Aadhaar?
text:
What is the difference in resident foreign nationals Aadhaar?
Aadhaar issued to Resident Foreign National shall have validity period mentioned on it as under: 1. In case of Indian VISA including LTV holder as validity of VISA. 2. In case of OCI card holder and Nationals of Nepal and Bhutan validity 10 years from the date of enrolment.

title: Where can resident Foreign Nationals enroll for Aadhaar?
text:
Where can resident Foreign Nationals enroll for Aadhaar?
At present resident foreign nationals are seeking Aadhaar enrolment to visit UIDAI Aadhaar Seva Kendra. Details available at: https://uidai.gov.in/en/ecosystem/enrolment-ecosystem/aadhaar-seva-kendra.html

title: Whether email is mandatory for a resident foreigner to enroll for Aadhaar ?
text:
Whether email is mandatory for a resident foreigner to enroll for Aadhaar ?
Yes, email is mandatory for enrolment, which shall be validated through OTP during enrolment.

title: I am a citizen of Nepal/Bhutan do I need to enroll as Foreign Nationals for getting Aadhaar?
text:
I am a citizen of Nepal/Bhutan do I need to enroll as Foreign Nationals for getting Aadhaar?
Yes, citizens of Nepal/Bhutan can enroll as Resident Foreign National for Aadhaar.

title: What supporting documents are required for enrolment as a citizen of Nepal/Bhutan ?
text:
What supporting documents are required for enrolment as a citizen of Nepal/Bhutan ?
Documents required: POI: Passport of Nepal/Bhutan for nationals of Nepal/Bhutan. In case passport is not available, any two of the following documents having the same address may be submitted: (a) Nepalese/ Bhutanese Citizenship Certificate. (b) Valid Voter Identity Card issued by the Election Commission of Nepal/ Bhutan. (c) Limited validity Photo Identity Certificate issued by Nepalese Mission/ Royal Bhutanese Mission in India. POA: Any document having Indian address from list of valid supporting document. For detail list of valid documents please visit: List of Supporting Documents

title: I am a Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) card holder do I need to enroll as Foreign Nationals for getting Aadhaar?
text:
I am a Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) card holder do I need to enroll as Foreign Nationals for getting Aadhaar?
Yes, OCI card holders can enroll as Resident Foreign National for Aadhaar.

title: What supporting documents are required for enrolment of OCI card holder ?
text:
What supporting documents are required for enrolment of OCI card holder ?
Documents required: POI: Valid OCI card, along with valid foreign passport. POA: Any document having Indian address from list of valid supporting document. For detail list of valid documents please visit: List of Supporting Documents

text:
I am a Long-Term Visa (LTV) holder from the country Afghanistan or Bangladesh or Pakistan do I need to enroll as Foreign Nationals for getting Aadhaar?
Yes, LTV holders can enroll as Resident Foreign National for Aadhaar.

title: What supporting documents are required for enrolment of LTV holder ?
text:
What supporting documents are required for enrolment of LTV holder ?
Documents required For POI: Valid Long-Term Visa (LTV) document, along with foreign passport (valid or expired), of the country of origin, issued to nationals of Afghanistan, Bangladesh and Pakistan. For POA: Valid Long-Term Visa (LTV) document OR Any document having Indian address from list of valid supporting document. For detail list of valid documents please visit: List of Supporting Documents

title: After enrolment for Aadhaar I got acknowledgement slip containing SID number is it valid?
text:
After enrolment for Aadhaar I got acknowledgement slip containing SID number is it valid?
Communication/acknowledgement slip received with SID number is valid. SID number starts with letter ‘S’ and followed by 27 digits.

title: I enrolled for Aadhaar as a foreign national, from where do I get the status against the SID?
text:
I enrolled for Aadhaar as a foreign national, from where do I get the status against the SID?

title: When Mandatory Biometric Update is to be conducted?
text:
When Mandatory Biometric Update is to be conducted?
1. When child attains an age of 5 years all biometric (Photo, Finger Prints and both Iris) data would be recorded. A de-duplication would be done for the child at this stage. This request will be treated similar to a new enrolment request while retaining the original Aadhaar number. This biometric update is free of cost. 2. When Aadhaar number holder attains age of 15 years, should furnish all biometrics (Photo, Finger Prints and both Iris) for update. This biometric update is free of cost.

title: What are the charges for Mandatory Biometric Update?
text:
What are the charges for Mandatory Biometric Update?
(i) If done once between the age of 5 to7 years: Free (ii) If done once between the age of 15 to 17 years: Free

text:
Where can I get Mandatory Biometric Update performed?
Aadhaar number holder needs to visit an Aadhaar Enrolment centre, with Aadhaar number for Mandatory Biometric Update. Address of Aadhaar Enrolment centres is available at Bhuvan portal: Bhuvan Aadhaar Portal

title: What is e-Aadhaar?
text:
What is e-Aadhaar?
e-Aadhaar is a password protected electronic copy of Aadhaar, digitally signed by UIDAI.

title: Is e-Aadhaar equally valid like physical copy of Aadhaar?
text:
Is e-Aadhaar equally valid like physical copy of Aadhaar?
Yes, e-Aadhaar is equally valid like physical copy of Aadhaar. For validity of eAadhaar, please refer UIDAI circular- F.No. 140 l4 l8l20ll -Logistics Vol.ll Dated 28th April, 2017. It can be accessed through https://uidai.gov.in/images/Circular_dated_28_April_2017.pdf

title: From where an Aadhaar number holder can download e-Aadhaar?
text:
From where an Aadhaar number holder can download e-Aadhaar?
Aadhaar Number holder can download e-Aadhaar by visiting UIDAI's myAadhaar portal - https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in/genricDownloadAadhaar/en or by using Aadhaar app for mobile phones.

title: How can an Aadhaar Number holder download e-Aadhaar?
text:
How can an Aadhaar Number holder download e-Aadhaar?
An Aadhaar number holder can download e-Aadhaar through following ways: By Using Enrolment Number By Using Aadhaar No By using VID By using SID

title: What is Masked Aadhaar?
text:
What is Masked Aadhaar?
In Masked Aadhaar, first 8 digits of Aadhaar number are masked and only last 4 digits of the Aadhaar number are visible. Facility of Masked Aadhaar is available only in e-Aadhaar.

title: What Is the Password of e-Aadhaar?
text:
What Is the Password of e-Aadhaar?
Password of eAadhaar is a combination of the first 4 letters of name in CAPITAL and the year of birth (YYYY). For Example: Example 1 Name: SURESH KUMAR Year of Birth: 1990 Password: SURE1990 Example 2 Name: SAI KUMAR Year of Birth: 1990 Password: SAIK1990 Example 3 Name: P. KUMAR Year of Birth: 1990 Password: P.KU1990 Example 4 Name: RIA Year of Birth: 1990 Password: RIA1990

title: What supporting software needed to view e-Aadhaar?

What supporting software needed to view e-Aadhaar?
Resident needs latest version of 'Adobe Reader' to view e-Aadhaar.

title: How to validate digital signatures in e-Aadhaar?
text:
How to validate digital signatures in e-Aadhaar?
To successfully validate the digital signature on e-Aadhaar UIDAI recommends to download and open the e-Aadhaar in the latest version of Adobe Acrobat Reader on Microsoft Windows/MacOS .

title: What is Virtual ID (VID)?
text:
What is Virtual ID (VID)?
VID is a temporary, revocable 16-digit random number mapped with the Aadhaar number. VID can be used in lieu of Aadhaar number whenever authentication or e-KYC services are performed. Authentication may be performed using VID in a manner similar to using Aadhaar number. It is not possible to derive Aadhaar number from VID.

title: How does an Aadhaar number holder obtain VID?
text:
How does an Aadhaar number holder obtain VID?
VID can be generated only by the Aadhaar number holder. They can also replace (generate a new VID) their VID from time to time. At any given time only one VID will be valid for an Aadhaar number. UIDAI provide various options to Aadhaar number holders to generate their VID, retrieve their VID in case they forget, and replace their VID with a new number. These options will be made available via UIDAI’s website ( www.myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in ), eAadhaar download, Aadhaar mobile application, etc. VID can also be generated by sending an SMS to the Aadhaar helpline number 1947. Aadhaar number holder will have to type “GVIDLast 4 digits of Aadhaar Number” and send it to 1947 through the registered Mobile Number.

title: Can anyone else generate VID for me?
text:
Can anyone else generate VID for me?
No other entity like AUA/KUA can generate VID on behalf of Aadhaar number holder. The VID can be generated by Aadhaar number holder by himself/herself only. Aadhaar number holder will receive the VID through SMS on registered mobile number.

title: What if an Aadhaar number holder forgets VID? Can he/she obtain again?
text:
What if an Aadhaar number holder forgets VID? Can he/she obtain again?
Yes, UIDAI provide multiple ways to generate new and/or retrieve current VID. These options are made available via UIDAI’s website ( www.myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in ), eAadhaar, Aadhaar mobile application, SMS, etc. For retrieval of VID, Aadhaar number holder may send SMS to the Aadhaar helpline number 1947. Aadhaar number holder will have to type “RVID Last 4 digits of Aadhaar Number” and send it to 1947 through the registered Mobile Number.

title: Can VID be used for OTP or biometrics or demographics authentication?
text:
Can VID be used for OTP or biometrics or demographics authentication?
Yes. VID can be used in lieu of Aadhaar number to perform Aadhaar Authentication.

title: In case of VID, do I need to provide consent for authentication?
text:
In case of VID, do I need to provide consent for authentication?
Yes, Aadhaar number holder consent is necessary for VID based authentication. Agency is required to inform the Aadhaar number holder the purpose for authentication and collect explicit consent for performing authentication.

title: Can an agency store VID?
text:
Can an agency store VID?
No. Since VID is temporary and can be changed by the Aadhaar number holder, storing VID has no value. Agencies should not store VID in any database or logs.

title: Will re-generation of VID lead to the same VID or a different VID?
text:
Will re-generation of VID lead to the same VID or a different VID?
After the minimum validity period (currently set as 1 calender day or after midnight 12), Aadhaar number holder may requests regeneration of a new VID. In this way, new VID will be generated and the previous VID will be deactivated. In case, if Aadhaar number holder opts for retrieval of VID, the last active VID will be sent to the Aadhaar number holder through SMS. Aadhaar number holder will have to type “RVIDLast 4 digits of Aadhaar Number” and send it to 1947 through the registered Mobile Number.

title: What is the expiry period of VID?
text:
What is the expiry period of VID?
At this time there is no expiry period defined for VID. VID will be valid till the time a new VID is generated by the Aadhaar number holder.

title: How can I update my demographic details in Aadhaar?
text:
How can I update my demographic details in Aadhaar?
You can update your demographic details in Aadhaar By enrolling through nearest enrolment centre. You can search the nearest enrolment centre by clicking https://bhuvan.nrsc.gov.in/aadhaar/ Using Online services for address update and document update available at https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in/

title: Is it necessary that my mobile number should be registered with Aadhaar while requesting for any kind of update through online?
text:
Is it necessary that my mobile number should be registered with Aadhaar while requesting for any kind of update through online?
Yes, mobile number should be registered to Aadhaar for using online services.

text:
Where can I update my mobile number?
You can update your mobile number by visiting any Aadhaar Enrolment centre. Aadhaar Enrolment centre can be located by visiting at Bhuvan portal: https://bhuvan-app3.nrsc.gov.in/aadhaar/

title: Can I update my address in my local language through online portal?
text:
Can I update my address in my local language through online portal?
You have to enter the details in English, which shall be transliterated into your selected regional language. You can update for any correction in transliteration if required. The following regional languages are available for update of address through online. Bengali, Gujarati, Hindi, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu and Urdu.

title: I successfully submitted my address update request. How can I track this?
text:
I successfully submitted my address update request. How can I track this?
On successful submission of an online address update request, a SRN (Service Request Number) is generated, which is shown on screen and also sent via SMS to your registered mobile number. After successful submission of the request, please download the invoice containing the SRN number and other details. The status of the update request can be checked at the bottom of the page by login in to Check Aadhaar Update Status

title: My online address update request got rejected for invalid documents. What does this mean?
text:
My online address update request got rejected for invalid documents. What does this mean?
Aadhaar update requests to be supported by valid/proof of address (POA) document. A request can be rejected for invalid document in following scenarios: The Proof of Address(POA) document should be a Valid document, as per document list available at List of Supporting Document Document is in the name of the Aadhaar holder for whom update request is submitted. Address details entered should match the address with the address mentioned in the document. Image uploaded should be clear and colored scan of original document.

title: What is Aadhaar QR Code? What information does QR Code contain?
text:
What is Aadhaar QR Code? What information does QR Code contain?
Aadhaar QR code is Quick Response code digitally signed by UIDAI and used for offline verification of identity. It is present on all forms of Aadhaar like e-Aadhaar, Aadhaar letter, Aadhaar PVC card and Aadhaar App. It contains last 4 digits of Aadhaar number, name, address, gender, date of birth and photograph of the Aadhaar number holder. It also contains masked mobile number and email-id of the Aadhaar number holder.

title: What are the benefits of Aadhaar QR code?
text:
What are the benefits of Aadhaar QR code?
Aadhaar QR code can be used for verification of identity in offline mode. 'Aadhaar QR Code Scanner' app for smartphones and Windows based QR code scanning application works in Offline mode and does not require internet for scanning purpose.

title: How can someone read Aadhaar QR code?
text:
How can someone read Aadhaar QR code?
Aadhaar QR code can ONLY be read using: 1. Aadhaar app available on Google Play Store and app store 2. Aadhaar QR Scanner app available on Google Play Store and app store 3. Windows based application available on UIDAI official website - https://uidai.gov.in/qr-code-reader

title: How Windows QR code Scanner Application will work?
text:
How Windows QR code Scanner Application will work?
Post installation of UIDAI’s QR code reader application, QR code of e-Aadhaar need to be scanned using the physical scanner in line with UIDAI Specifications. The application will display the demographic details of Aadhaar number holder once the QR Code is digitally verified using Windows QR code scanner.

title: Who all can use secure QR code?
text:
Who all can use secure QR code?
Any Aadhaar Holder or any User/Service Agencies like Banks, AUAs, KUAs, Hotels etc can use this facility for offline verification of the data in Aadhaar.

title: What is Aadhaar Paperless Offline e-KYC?
text:
What is Aadhaar Paperless Offline e-KYC?
It is a secure sharable document which can be used by any Aadhaar number holder for offline verification of Identification. An Aadhaar number holder desirous of using this facility shall generate his/her digitally signed Offline XML by accessing UIDAI website. The Offline XML will contain Name, Address, Photo, Gender, DOB, hash of registered Mobile Number, hash of registered Email Address and reference id which contains last 4 digits of Aadhaar Number followed by time stamp. It will provide Offline Aadhaar Verification facility to service providers/Offline Verification Seeking Entity (OVSE) without the need to collect or store Aadhaar number.

title: How to generate Offline Aadhaar XML?
text:
How to generate Offline Aadhaar XML?
The process of generating Aadhaar Offline e-KYC is explained below: • Go to URL https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in/offline-ekyc • Enter ‘Aadhaar Number’ or ‘VID’ and enter mentioned ‘Security Code’ in screen, then click on ‘Send OTP’. The OTP will be sent to the registered Mobile Number for the given Aadhaar number or VID. OTP will be available on Aadhaar mobile Application of UIDAI. Enter the OTP received. Enter a Share Code which be the password for the ZIP file and click on ‘Download’ button • The Zip file containing the digitally signed XML will be downloaded to device wherein the above mentioned steps have been performed. The Offline Aadhaar XML can also be downloaded from Aadhaar app. In next step, after successful validation, i.Select the required details which you want to download by clicking the radio button. ii.Enter the desired ‘Share Code’ for the ZIP file in the provided field with required parameters as indicated in screen iii.Enter the ‘Security Code’ and press ‘Submit’ button The Zip file containing the digitally signed XML will be downloaded to device wherein the above mentioned steps have been performed. Extract the zip file using the password as specified in previous step and save the XML file in the desired location

title: Who are the users of this Aadhaar Paperless Offline e-KYC?
text:
Who are the users of this Aadhaar Paperless Offline e-KYC?
Any Aadhaar number holder who desires to establish his/her identity to any service provider (OVSE) using digitally signed XML downloaded from UIDAI website can be a user of this service. The service provider should have provisions of providing this Aadhaar Paperless Offline e-KYC at their facility and do the offline verification

title: How to share this Paperless Offline eKYC document with the service provider?
text:
How to share this Paperless Offline eKYC document with the service provider?
Aadhaar number holders can share the XML ZIP file along with the Share Code to the service provider as per their mutual convenience.

title: How will service providers use Aadhaar Offline e-KYC?
text:
How will service providers use Aadhaar Offline e-KYC?
The process of Aadhaar Offline e-KYC Verification by Service Provider is: Once service provider obtains the ZIP file, it extracts the XML file using the password (share code) provided by the Aadhaar number holder. The XML file will contain the demographic details such as Name, DOB, Gender and Address. Photo is in base 64 encoded format which can be rendered directly using any utility or plane HTML page. Email Address and Mobile number are hashed. Service Provider has to collect Email Address and Mobile number from Aadhaar number holders and perform below operations in order to validate the hash: Mobile Number: Hashing logic: Sha256(Sha256(Mobile+ShareCode))*number of times of last digit of Aadhaar Number Example : Mobile number: 9800000002 Aadhaar Number: 123412341234 Share Code: Abc@123 Sha256(Sha256(9800000002+ Abc@123))*4 In case if Aadhaar Number ends with Zero or 1 (123412341230/1) it will be hashed one time. Sha256(Sha256(9800000002+ Abc@123))*1 Email Address: Hashing Logic: This is a simple SHA256 hash of the email without any salt Entire XML is digitally signed and Service Provider can validate the XML file using the signature and public key available on the UIDAI website.( https://uidai.gov.in/images/uidai_offline_publickey_26022019.cer ).

title: Can this Offline Paperless eKYC document be shared to other entities by the Service Provider?
text:
Can this Offline Paperless eKYC document be shared to other entities by the Service Provider?
Service Providers shall not share, publish or display either XML or Share Code or its contents with anyone else. Any non-compliance of these actions shall invite actions under Sections 29(2), 29 (3), 29(4) and 37 of The Aadhaar Act, 2016 (as amended) and sub regulation 1A of regulation 25, regulation 14A of The Aadhaar (Authentication and Offline Verification) Regulation, 2021 and regulation 6 and 7 of The Aadhaar (Sharing of Information) Regulation, 2016.

title: How this Aadhaar Offline Paperless eKYC document is different from the other identification documents produced offline by individuals?
text:
How this Aadhaar Offline Paperless eKYC document is different from the other identification documents produced offline by individuals?
Identity verification can simply be accomplished by providing an identity document like PAN card, Passport etc to the service provider. However, all these documents, which may be used for identification can still be forged and faked which may or may not be possible to verify offline instantaneously. The document verifier has no technological means to verify the authenticity of the document or the information it contains and has to trust the document producer. Whereas, the XML file generated by the Aadhaar number holder using Aadhaar Paperless Offline e-KYC is digitally signed document using UIDAI digital signature. Thus, the service provider can verify the demographic contents of the file and certify it to be authentic when doing the offline verification

title: What is Biometric Locking?
text:
What is Biometric Locking?
Biometric Locking/Unlocking is a service that allows an Aadhaar holder to lock and temporarily unlock their biometrics. This facility aims to strengthen privacy and confidentiality of Aadhaar number holder's Biometrics Data.

title: What all Biometric data can be locked?
text:
What all Biometric data can be locked?
Fingerprint, iris and Face as a biometric moadlity will be locked and after biometric locking, Aadhaar holder will not be able to perform the Aadhaar authentication using the above mentioned biometric modalities.

title: What happens when Biometric is locked?
text:
What happens when Biometric is locked?
Locked Biometrics confirms that Aadhaar holder will not be able to use Biometrics (fingerprints/iris/Face) for authentication, it is a safety feature to stop any kind of biometric authentication. It also ensures that any entity by any means cannot perform biometric based Aadhaar authentication for that Aadhaar holder.

title: How to Unlock (locked)Biometrics?
text:
How to Unlock (locked)Biometrics?
Once Aadhaar number holder enables Biometric Locking system their biometric remains locked till the Aadhaar Holder chose any below mentioned option: Unlock it (which is temporary )or Disable the Locking system The biometric unlock can be done by Aadhaar number holder either by visiting UIDAI website, enrolment centre, Aadhaar Seva Kendra(ASK), through Aadhaar app. Note: Registered Mobile Number is essential to avail this service. In case your mobile number is not registered with Aadhaar visit the nearest Enrolment Centre/Mobile Update End Point.

title: Who and when to lock Biometrics?
text:
Who and when to lock Biometrics?
Aadhaar number holders who have registered mobile number may lock their biometrics. This facility aims to strengthen privacy and confidentiality of Aadhaar number holder 's Biometrics Data After locking biometrics if a UID is used for invoking any of the Authentication services using a biometric modality (Fingerprint/Iris/Face) a specific error code '330' indicating biometrics are locked will be displayed and the entity will not be able to perform the biometric authentication.

title: What is Aadhaar (UID) Lock & Unlock?
text:
What is Aadhaar (UID) Lock & Unlock?
For an Aadhaar number holder, security and privacy of personal data is always a primary concern. To strengthen the security of his/her Aadhaar number and to provide control to the Aadhaar number holder, UIDAI provide a mechanism of locking and unlocking Aadhaar number (UID). Aadhaar number holder can lock his or her Aadhaar (UID) via UIDAI website ( www.myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in ). By doing this Aadhaar number holder cannot perform any sort of Authentication using UID, UID Token & VID for Biometrics, Demographic & OTP modality If Aadhaar number holder wants to unlock UID he/she can do so by using latest VID, through UIDAI website. After unlocking Aadhaar (UID), Aadhaar number holder can perform authentication using UID, UID Token & VID.

title: How can Aadhaar number holder Lock UID?
text:
How can Aadhaar number holder Lock UID?
For Locking UID, Aadhaar number holder should have 16 digit VID number and it's a pre-requisite for locking. If Aadhaar number holder don't have VID can generate via SMS Service or UIDAI website ( www.myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in ). SMS Service. GVID space last 4 or 8 digit of UID. SMS to 1947. Ex- GVID 1234. Aadhaar number holder may visit UIDAI website ( https://resident.uidai.gov.in/aadhaar-lockunlock ), Under My Aadhaar tab, Click on Aadhaar Lock & Unlock services. Select UID Lock Radio Button and enter UID Number, Full Name, and Pin Code as in latest details and enter Security code. Click on Send OTP or select TOTP and click on submit. Your UID will be locked successfully.

title: How can Aadhaar number holder Unlock UID ?
text:
How can Aadhaar number holder Unlock UID ?
For Unlocking UID Aadhaar number holder should have latest 16 digit VID and if Aadhaar number holder forgot 16 digit VID he can retrieve latest VID through SMS services RVID Space last 4 or 8 digit of UID. SMS to 1947. Ex- RVID 1234 To unlock UID, Aadhaar number holder may visit UIDAI website ( https://myaadhaarbeta.uidai.gov.in/lock-unlock-aadhaar/en ), select Unlock radio button, Enter Latest VID and security Code and click on send OTP or select TOTP and click on Submit. Your UID will be unlocked successfully.

title: I forgot my VID. How can I get it after locking UID?
text:
I forgot my VID. How can I get it after locking UID?
After Locking UID if Aadhaar number holder forgot VID, Aadhaar number holder can make use of SMS service to Retrieve 16 digit VID. Aadhaar number holder will receive VID on his/her register mobile number. Send SMS to 1947 from Aadhaar Register mobile number, RVID Space last 4 or 8 digit of UID. Ex:- RVID 1234

title: Do I need to generate OTP for all Aadhaar SMS services?
text:
Do I need to generate OTP for all Aadhaar SMS services?
OTP Auhtentication is must for Aadhaar Lock/unlock and Biometric Lock/unlock Function. You don’t need OTP for VID Generation & Retrieval function. To get OTP send SMS -> GETOTP LAST 4 or 8 DIGITs of Aadhaar Number Example - GETOTP 1234.

title: How to Lock/Unlock Aadhaar Number with SMS service?
text:
How to Lock/Unlock Aadhaar Number with SMS service?
For Locking Aadhaar Number: Send OTP request as -> GETOTP LAST 4 or 8 DIGITs of Aadhaar Number Then send Locking Request as -> LOCKUID Last 4 or 8 DIGIT of Aadhaar Number 6 DIGIT OTP You will get a confirmation message for your request. Once it is locked you will not be able to perform any form of Authentication (Biometric, Demographic or OTP) using your Aadhaar Number. However, you can still use your latest Virtual ID for performing Authentication. For Un-Locking Aadhaar Number you must have your latest Virtual ID. Send OTP request with last 6 or 10 DIGITs of Virtual ID number as -> GETOTP LAST 6 or 10 DIGITs Virtual ID Then send Unlocking Request as -> UNLOCKUID LAST 6 or 10 DIGIT Virtual ID 6 DIGIT OTP

title: My SMS is not being sent. What should I do?
text:
My SMS is not being sent. What should I do?
Please check if your SMS service is working properly. In case of any issue with respect to the SMS not being sent, kindly contact your telecom service provider. It may be a case of bad network or non-functioning SMS service or low Balance etc

title: Is the Aadhaar PVC Card different from the Aadhaar letter?
text:
Is the Aadhaar PVC Card different from the Aadhaar letter?
No, the Aadhaar PVC Card is just a compact and more durable version. It holds the same validity as the e-Aadhaar and paper Aadhaar letter.

title: What is Aadhaar PVC Card?
text:
What is Aadhaar PVC Card?
The Aadhaar PVC Card is a durable, credit-card-sized version of Aadhaar with enhanced security features. It can be ordered online for ₹75 through the UIDAI website.

title: Can I reorder Aadhaar PVC Card?
text:
Can I reorder Aadhaar PVC Card?
Yes, you can reorder Aadhaar PVC card multiple times.

title: How many days will it take to receive "Aadhaar PVC Card" after placing the order successfully?
text:
How many days will it take to receive "Aadhaar PVC Card" after placing the order successfully?
On receipt of  successful request from the Aadhaar Number Holder, Aadhaar PVC card is delivered normally within 10 working days (excluding day of raising request) through Speed post services of India Post at the address registered with UIDAI.  Consignment Number/AWB is sent to the registered mobile number of ANH and same can be tracked on https://www.indiapost.gov.in .

title: What are the different forms of Aadhaar?
text:
What are the different forms of Aadhaar?
The different forms of Aadhaar are Aadhaar Letter, Aadhaar PVC card, eAadhaar  which are equally valid and acceptable.

title: What is “Order Aadhaar PVC Card” service?
text:
What is “Order Aadhaar PVC Card” service?
“Order Aadhaar PVC Card” is an online service launched by UIDAI which facilitates the Aadhaar holder to get their Aadhaar details printed on PVC card by paying nominal charges.

title: What are the security features of “Aadhaar PVC Card”?
text:
What are the security features of “Aadhaar PVC Card”?
This card contains security features like: 1. Tamper proof QR Code 2. Micro text 3. Ghost image 4. Issue Date & Details as on Date 5. Guilloche Pattern 6. Embossed Aadhaar Logo

title: What are the charges to be paid for “Aadhaar PVC Card”?
text:
What are the charges to be paid for “Aadhaar PVC Card”?
Charges to be paid are Rs.75/- (Inclusive of GST & speed post charges).

title: How one can raise the request for “Aadhaar PVC Card”?
text:
How one can raise the request for “Aadhaar PVC Card”?
"Aadhaar PVC Card" request can be raised by visiting the UIDAI Official Website ( https://www.uidai.gov.in or https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in/genricPVC ).

title: How to Raise Request using Registered Mobile Number?
text:
How to Raise Request using Registered Mobile Number?
Please Visit https://uidai.gov.in or https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in/genricPVC Click on “Order Aadhaar Card” Service or Aadhaar application to order Enter your 12 digit Aadhaar Number (UID) or 16 digit Virtual Identification Number (VID) or 28 digits Enrollment ID. Enter the security code If you have TOTP, choose option “I have TOTP” by clicking in check box else Click on “Request OTP” button. Enter OTP/TOTP received on registered mobile number. Click on “Make payment”. You will be re-directed to Payment Gateway page with payment options as Credit/Debit Card, Net banking and UPI. After successful payment, receipt will get generated having digital signature which can be downloaded by resident in PDF format. Resident will also get the Service Request Number via SMS. Resident can track the status of SRN till dispatch of Aadhaar Card on Check Aadhaar Card Status. SMS containing AWB number will also be sent once dispatched from DoP. Resident can further track delivery status by visiting DoP website.

title: How to raise Request using Non-Registered/Alternate Mobile Number?
text:
How to raise Request using Non-Registered/Alternate Mobile Number?
Please Visit https://uidai.gov.in or https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in/genricPVC Click on “Order Aadhaar Card” Service or Aadhaar application Enter your 12 digit Aadhaar Number (UID) or or 28 digits Enrollment ID. Enter the security code Click on check box “If you do not have a registered mobile number, please check in the box”. Please enter Non-Registered / Alternate Mobile Number. Preview will not be available for residents ordering using non-registered mobile number. Rest of the steps for ordering remains the same.

title: Which modes are available to make the payment?
text:
Which modes are available to make the payment?
Presently, the payment of Rs 50 can be made using Online Mode of Payment. Residents can use following payment methods while making payment:- Credit Card Debit Card Net Banking UPI Wallet

title: What is SRN?
text:
What is SRN?
SRN is 14 digits Service Request Number which is generated after raising request for Aadhaar PVC Card for future reference and correspondence.

title: What is AWB number?
text:
What is AWB number?
Airway Bill Number is the tracking number that is generated by DoP i.e. India Speed Post for the assignment/product that they deliver.

title: What if Aadhaar Number holder wants to get the Aadhaar PVC Card printed with the details different from existing details on Aadhaar?
text:
What if Aadhaar Number holder wants to get the Aadhaar PVC Card printed with the details different from existing details on Aadhaar?
If Aadhaar number holder wants some changes in the details of printed Aadhaar letter or PVC Card, then he/she first need to update their Aadhaar by visiting Enrollment Center or myAadhaar portal (depending on update) and then raise the request for Aadhaar PVC Card only after update is successful

title: Is there any mandate that after a certain period of time, a person needs to update their Aadhaar picture? (Or update the personal details)
text:
Is there any mandate that after a certain period of time, a person needs to update their Aadhaar picture? (Or update the personal details)
UIDAI suggest the Aadhaar number holder to update his or her document or information regarding proof of identity (POI) , proof of address (POA) at least once in 10 years from date of generation of Aadhaar number.

title: Why should I update documents in my Aadhaar?
text:
Why should I update documents in my Aadhaar?
You may update the documents in your Aadhaar database for better service delivery and accurate Aadhaar based authentication. Therefore, updating recent identity and address documents is in the interest of the Aadhaar number holder.

title: What documents can I submit to update document in Aadhaar?
text:
What documents can I submit to update document in Aadhaar?
To update document, you have to submit your Proof of Identity (POI) and Proof of Address (POA). Some common documents accepted as both POI and POA: Ration card Voter identity card Bhamashah, Domicile Certificate, Resident Certificate, Jan-Aadhaar, MGNREGA/ NREGS Job Card, Labour Card etc. Indian passport Passbook with photograph issued by Public Sector Bank along with certificate by branch manager/incharge Some common documents accepted as POI only: School leaving certificate / school transfer certificate with photograph Marksheet/certificate issued by recognised Board of Education or University with photograph PAN/e-PAN card CGHS Card Driving license Some common documents accepted as POA only: Electricity, water, gas or telephone/mobile/broadband bill (not more than three months old) Duly signed and stamped Scheduled Commercial Bank / Post Office passbook with photograph Duly signed and stamped Scheduled Commercial Bank / Post Office account/credit-card statement (not more than three months old) Valid rent, lease or leave & licence agreement Certificate issued in UIDAI Standard Certificate format by designated officers Property tax receipt (not more than one year old) Detailed list of supporting documents is available at - List of Supporting Document

title: How can I submit the documents online?
text:
How can I submit the documents online?
Please visit myAadhaar Portal , and log in using your Aadhaar number and one-time password (OTP) received on your registered mobile number. List of supporting documents is available at - List of Supporting Document

title: If the address displayed in my profile does not match with my current address, what should I do?
text:
If the address displayed in my profile does not match with my current address, what should I do?
You can update your address online through myAadhaar portal or by visiting any Aadhaar Enrolment Centre by enrolling with valid POA document.

title: If any demographic detail (name, gender or date of birth) does not match my actual identity details, what should I do?
text:
If any demographic detail (name, gender or date of birth) does not match my actual identity details, what should I do?
You can update any demographic details in Aadhaar by visiting any Aadhaar Enrolment centre

title: If I want to submit documents through Aadhaar enrolment centre, how can I locate an Aadhaar centre?
text:
If I want to submit documents through Aadhaar enrolment centre, how can I locate an Aadhaar centre?
Please go to Bhuvan Aadhaar Portal For locating nearby Aadhaar centres, click on the ‘Centres Nearby’ tab. Enter your location details to view nearby Aadhaar centres. For locating the Aadhaar centres within your PIN code area, click on the ‘Search by PIN Code’ tab. Enter your area PIN code to view Aadhaar centres in that area.

title: What is the charge for submitting the documents?
text:
What is the charge for submitting the documents?
For submission of documents at an Aadhaar centre, the applicable charge is Rs. 50. Submission of documents may also be done through myAadhaar portal .

title: By when should I submit the documents?
text:
By when should I submit the documents?
Aadhaar number holders are suggested to update documents in Aadhaar at least once in 10 years. Once you receive any communication in this regard, it is suggested to update the documents at an early date.

title: I am a non-resident Indian (NRI). How can I submit the documents?
text:
I am a non-resident Indian (NRI). How can I submit the documents?
You can submit the documents whenever you are in India, through online or by visiting Aadhaar Centre.

title: How can I submit the documents?
text:
How can I submit the documents?
The documents can be submitted online through myAadhaar Portal or at any Aadhaar Enrolment Centre. For a tutorial video in this regard, please click here https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1jne0KzFcF8

title: How to download the Aadhaar app?
text:
How to download the Aadhaar app?
You can download the Aadhaar app on your Android/iOS device from the Play Store/App Store. For Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.gov.uidai.pehchaan For iOS: https://apps.apple.com/in/app/aadhaar/id6744029871

title: What details are required for onboarding on the Aadhaar app?
text:
What details are required for onboarding on the Aadhaar app?
The ANH should have a smartphone (Android version 9.0 and above and iOS version 16.0 and above) with internet connectivity.

title: How to register on the Aadhaar app?
text:
How to register on the Aadhaar app?
After downloading the app, the Aadhaar Number Holder (ANH): →Select Language→ Enters their Aadhaar number →  Agrees to the Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy → Chooses the SIM card → Performs Face Authentication → Gets registered on the app →  Sets a 6-digit PIN to secure access to the app.

title: Which services are available on this app?
text:
Which services are available on this app?
Presently, the Aadhaar app offers various services like - Mobile Number Update, Address Update, Biometric lock/unlock, Selective Sharing of Aadhaar Verifiable Credential, check Authentication History, download e-Aadhaar, share Contact Card, Track my request, etc.

title: Who is an Aadhaar Number Holder (ANH)?
text:
Who is an Aadhaar Number Holder (ANH)?
ANH is an individual who has been assigned a 12-digit Aadhaar number by UIDAI.

title: Is this app available in other official languages?
text:
Is this app available in other official languages?
Yes, the Aadhaar app is available in 13 languages in total, English and 12 other Indian languages, including Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Gujarati, Odia, Punjabi, Marathi, Urdu, and Assamese.

title: How to update a mobile number through the Aadhaar app?
text:
How to update a mobile number through the Aadhaar app?
Scenario 1: If the Aadhaar Number Holder is registered on the Aadhaar app using the same mobile number that is registered with Aadhaar, ANH will be required to verify the new mobile number with OTP, perform Face Authentication, and pay the prescribed charges Scenario 2: If the Aadhaar Number Holder is registered on the Aadhaar app using a different mobile number from the one registered with Aadhaar, ANH will be required to verify both the old registered mobile number and the new mobile number with OTP, perform Face Authentication, and pay the prescribed charges Scenario 3: If the Aadhaar Number Holder does not have access to the old registered mobile number or has not registered a mobile number earlier, ANH must visit the nearest Aadhaar Seva Kendra or an authorised Aadhaar enrolment and update centre to update or register their mobile number.

title: Can a mobile number be registered in Aadhaar for the very first time using this app?
text:
Can a mobile number be registered in Aadhaar for the very first time using this app?
No, the user needs to visit the nearest Aadhaar Seva Kendra or Aadhaar enrolment and update centre for first time registering mobile number.

title: How to update address using own documents?
text:
How to update address using own documents?
Scenario 1: If the Aadhaar Number Holder is registered on the Aadhaar app using the same mobile number: To update your address in Aadhaar using documents: Open the Aadhaar App, login with your 6-digit PIN, go to Services → Address Update → upload your document (JPG/PNG/PDF), fill in the new address, verify the preview in English and local language, then complete Face Authentication and pay ₹75. Download the acknowledgement slip with your SRN number to track your request. Scenario 2: If the Aadhaar Number Holder is registered on the Aadhaar app using a different mobile number from the one registered with Aadhaar: Open the Aadhaar App, login with your 6-digit PIN, go to Services → Address Update → verify with OTP→ upload your document (JPG/PNG/PDF), fill in the new address, verify the preview in English and local language, then complete Face Authentication and pay ₹75. Download the acknowledgement slip with your SRN number to track your request.

title: How to update address using Family Member’s Aadhaar ?
text:
How to update address using Family Member’s Aadhaar ?
Scenario 1: If the Aadhaar Number Holder is registered on the Aadhaar app using the same mobile number: To update your address using HoF (Head of Family) method: Open Aadhaar App, login with 6-digit PIN, go to Services → Address Update → enter the family member's Aadhaar number, select your relation, complete Face Authentication and pay ₹75. The request goes to your family member (HoF), who must approve it from their Aadhaar App via Services → Family Member Request → enter SRN → Approve. Scenario 2: If the Aadhaar Number Holder is registered on the Aadhaar app using a different mobile number from the one registered with Aadhaar: To update your address using HoF (Head of Family) method: Open Aadhaar App, login with 6-digit PIN, go to Services → Address Update → Verify with OTP→ enter the family member's Aadhaar number, select your relation, complete Face Authentication and pay ₹75. The request goes to your family member (HoF), who must approve it from their Aadhaar App via Services → Family Member Request → enter SRN → Approve.

title: Can I update my Aadhaar details using the app?
text:
Can I update my Aadhaar details using the app?
Yes, currently you can update only your mobile number and address directly through the app, without visiting an Aadhaar Seva Kendra.

title: How to share contact card through Aadhaar app?
text:
How to share contact card through Aadhaar app?
Open Aadhaar App, login with your 6-digit PIN, then go to Services → Share Contact and show the QR code to the receiver. The receiver can scan it with any mobile camera to instantly save your name and mobile number in their contacts.

title: Can Name, Gender, Email, and DoB be updated through the Aadhaar app?
text:
Can Name, Gender, Email, and DoB be updated through the Aadhaar app?
Currently, these updates are not available through the Aadhaar app. For these updates, ANH may visit the nearest Aadhaar Seva Kendra or Aadhaar update and enrolment centre. In the future, these services may be made available in the Aadhaar App in phased manner.

title: Can Photo, Fingerprints, and Iris details be updated through the Aadhaar app?
text:
Can Photo, Fingerprints, and Iris details be updated through the Aadhaar app?
No, the biometric details (Photo, Fingerprints, and Iris) can only be updated by visiting an Aadhaar Seva Kendra or the Aadhaar enrolment and update centre.

title: Can this app be used at places where physical copies of Aadhaar are currently requested?
text:
Can this app be used at places where physical copies of Aadhaar are currently requested?
Yes. The Aadhaar app is an official application developed and managed by UIDAI. The app allows an Aadhaar Number Holder (ANH) to securely share their Aadhaar data with an Offline Verification Seeking Entity (OVSE), as per their consent and choice.

title: Can we lock/unlock Biometrics with this app?
text:
Can we lock/unlock Biometrics with this app?
Yes. The Aadhaar app provides a one-click biometric lock/unlock facility, which helps keep Aadhaar data safe and secure.

title: Can a user create multiple profiles on the Aadhaar app?
text:
Can a user create multiple profiles on the Aadhaar app?
Yes, any individual with a valid Aadhaar number can create up to five profiles on the Aadhaar app.

title: How to add the profile of a minor in the app?
text:
How to add the profile of a minor in the app?
A minor (below 18 years of age) can be added to the Aadhaar app if their relationship with the guardian was established through biometric authentication at the time of Aadhaar enrolment. The minor enters their Aadhaar number, after which the guardian completes face authentication. Once the guardian’s face authentication is successful, the minor’s profile is added to the app. If the Mandatory Biometric Update (MBU) of the minor has already been completed, the minor will perform face authentication instead of the guardian.

title: Can this app be used outside India?
text:
Can this app be used outside India?
No, the Aadhaar app cannot be used outside India.

title: Why does the app need different permissions, such as camera, SMS, and call ?
text:
Why does the app need different permissions, such as camera, SMS, and call ?
Call and SMS permissions are required for SIM-based device binding, similar to payment apps. These permissions help identify the active SIM and securely send or read verification SMS. Camera permission is required for face authentication and verification to access Aadhaar services.

title: What is an Aadhaar Verifiable Credential in the context of the Aadhaar App?
text:
What is an Aadhaar Verifiable Credential in the context of the Aadhaar App?
An Aadhaar Verifiable Credential is a digitally signed document issued by the 

Authority to the Aadhaar Number Holder. It may contain the last 4 digits of the Aadhaar number, demographic data such as name, address, gender, date of birth, and photograph of the Aadhaar Number Holder, and such other information as may be specified by the Authority. These credentials may be shared by the Aadhaar Number Holder, in full or in part, with an OVSE in the manner specified by the Authority, for verifying the demographic information or the photograph of the Aadhaar Number Holder.

title: Can I share my Aadhaar Verifiable Credentials (demographic details) through this app?
text:
Can I share my Aadhaar Verifiable Credentials (demographic details) through this app?
Yes. An Aadhaar Number Holder (ANH) can share Aadhaar Verifiable Credentials in full or in part. The shared credentials may include a combination of demographic details, including the photograph, based on the user’s consent.

title: Can the Aadhaar App be used to access and share the user’s current location?
text:
Can the Aadhaar App be used to access and share the user’s current location?
No, the Aadhaar app does not capture the location.

title: How does the app give me control over my data?
text:
How does the app give me control over my data?
The app places control over data sharing directly in the hands of the Aadhaar Number Holder. The ANH can choose to share Aadhaar data either full or in part, with whom, and for what purpose.

title: Which features of the Aadhaar app enable secure and private use of data?
text:
Which features of the Aadhaar app enable secure and private use of data?
The app includes face authentication-based onboarding, consent-based selective data sharing, and biometric lock features that protect identity and ensure that only Aadhaar Number Holders (ANH) can access their Aadhaar information.

title: Who should use the Aadhaar App?
text:
Who should use the Aadhaar App?
Any Aadhaar Number Holder who seeks a secure, convenient, and privacy-centric way to verify identity, share Aadhaar information, and manage personal identity data can use the Aadhaar App.

title: Can the Aadhaar app be used when the developer option is enabled?
text:
Can the Aadhaar app be used when the developer option is enabled?
No. The Aadhaar app cannot be used when developer mode is enabled. This restriction is implemented to ensure data security and user protection.

title: How can the Aadhaar Verifiable Credential file be read?
text:
How can the Aadhaar Verifiable Credential file be read?
Aadhaar Verifiable Credentials are machine-readable files that can be shared via WhatsApp or email. They can be read using UIDAI-issued tools and prescribed technical standards.

title: How is consent management handled in the Aadhaar app?
text:
How is consent management handled in the Aadhaar app?
Consent management in the Aadhaar app is governed by the Aadhaar Act and other applicable laws. No identity data is shared without the explicit consent of the Aadhaar Number Holder.

title: If data is updated by an Aadhaar Number Holder(ANH), how soon is it reflected in the Aadhaar App?
text:
If data is updated by an Aadhaar Number Holder(ANH), how soon is it reflected in the Aadhaar App?
The processing time for mobile number and/or address updates is up to 30 days. Once the update is successfully completed, the revised data is reflected in the Aadhaar app.

title: Will secure QR codes on PVC Aadhaar cards and e-Aadhaar continue to work, or will they be phased out?
text:
Will secure QR codes on PVC Aadhaar cards and e-Aadhaar continue to work, or will they be phased out?
QR codes on PVC Aadhaar cards and e-Aadhaar will continue to work and can be scanned easily using the Aadhaar App or Aadhaar QR Code scanner for identity verification.

title: Technically, what standard does the Aadhaar QR follow, and can any app read it?
text:
Technically, what standard does the Aadhaar QR follow, and can any app read it?
The QR-based verifiable presentation follows a UIDAI specification and OPENID4VP, but the reading capability is limited to the Aadhaar App, Aadhaar QR Code scanner only.

title: Does an entity need a specific SDK from UIDAI to generate QR codes, or is there a different approach?
text:
Does an entity need a specific SDK from UIDAI to generate QR codes, or is there a different approach?
No SDK is required. The OVSE must follow the QR generation guidelines issued by UIDAI. A registered OVSE may contact UIDAI for any technical support related to QR generation.

title: Online Aadhaar address update: login, OTP and supporting documents
text: The online mode offers address update to the Aadhaar number holders where the Aadhaar number holder can directly place the address update request on the myAadhaar portal. The Aadhaar number holder needs to have mobile number registered with Aadhaar for using this service. The Aadhaar number is required to login to the portal by the Aadhaar number holder. The Aadhaar number holder is authenticated using sent OTP on his/her registered mobile number. To complete the update process, Aadhaar number holder needs to upload the supporting POA documents Doc Type: PDF Size: 1.6MB , which will be verified against requested data at a later stage by a quality and processing team.
